recommendation_summary: Recommends building one Excel PivotTable on the existing table now, grouped by year and month and by region, summing signed net amounts so refunds reduce totals. Each month the user replaces the table data, refreshes the pivot and reconciles the grand total to the export. Nothing else is added now: the four-system stack is dropped, and the reply only says to revisit the architecture if a concrete need outgrows Excel. No unmet needs.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want a repeatable monthly board report of net sales by region, ready this week.
labels.Deleted: Airbyte, Snowflake, dbt and Power BI from this proposal; the described report does not need them.
labels.Bottleneck: You manually calculate regional monthly totals.
labels.Checked myself: You told me there is one local Excel table that fits comfortably on your computer, with dates, regions and signed amounts; I have not inspected it.

note: All four record lines come before a bounded PivotTable fix that keeps refunds negative, and the Checked myself line uses only facts the user supplied and says the file was not inspected.
